system.description: Range 30 feet. Rank 1: Grants one target advantage on their next check. Rank 3: Grants two targets advantage on their next check. Rank 5: Grants three targets advantage on their next check. Only one casting can be in effect at the same time. A greater success grants advantage on the next two checks; an extreme success grants advantage on the next three checks.
